text: I'm up with my granddaughter, she is 1 month old. Temperature 37.9. She has freckle-looking dots that weren't there this morning. Her skin is dark so you can't see much on her body but I looked at the palms of her hands and the soles of her feet and inside her mouth and they're there too. I pressed a glass on her foot and they don't fade. She keeps rubbing her hand at her ear and pulling at it. I've been awake since five, I can't think straight anymore.
